note: Held-out batch B (sealed). Hand-written from the RFP text before any tool run. No addendum. Layout: a solicitation data sheet of 'label ....: value' lines carrying the dates in ISO and DD-MON-YYYY form, then numbered schedules. Requirements are a tick-box checklist R1 to R10 in Schedule 3 plus three unnumbered questions in Schedule 4. Weights are printed as fractions of 1.00; the key gives them as percentages.

requirements.label: R1
requirements.text: Cover letter signed by an owner or officer of the firm.

requirements.label: R2
requirements.text: Firm profile: history, number of attorneys, offices, and the size of the water law practice.

requirements.label: R3
requirements.text: Team: the lead attorney and all supporting attorneys, each person's role, and resumes.

requirements.label: R4
requirements.text: Water rights experience: contested proceedings, water transfers and purchase contracts handled in the last ten years, with outcomes.

requirements.label: R5
requirements.text: Regulatory experience: work before state and federal water regulators, groundwater sustainability agencies and drought proceedings.

requirements.label: R6
requirements.text: Proposed approach to the pending water board proceeding and to the contract renegotiation, with a proposed work plan for the first six months.

requirements.label: R7
requirements.text: References: three public water supplier clients.

requirements.label: R8
requirements.text: Conflicts of interest: all current and former clients with interests in the Tamsel River watershed, and how any conflict would be managed.

requirements.label: R9
requirements.text: Fees: hourly rates, a budget estimate for the water board proceeding through hearing, and any alternative fee offer.

requirements.label: R10
requirements.text: Statement on local presence and use of local or small firms as subconsultants, if any.

requirements.label: S4-unnumbered-1
requirements.text: What is the firm's view of the main risks to the Commission's 1954 right, based only on the public record of the water board proceeding?

requirements.label: S4-unnumbered-2
requirements.text: If the lead attorney became unavailable for a month during the hearing, who would take over, and what has that person done that is comparable?

requirements.label: S4-unnumbered-3
requirements.text: Describe one matter in which the firm negotiated a long-term water purchase or transfer agreement for a public supplier. What terms did the firm obtain on price adjustment and shortage sharing?

forms: The ticked copy of the Schedule 3 checklist

min_quals.starts: Lead attorney: admitted to practice 12 years or longer
Lead attorney: has appeared as counsel of record
Firm: at least 2 attorneys other than the lead attorney
Firm: no current client relationship with either adverse party

min_qual_notes: T3 asks for two attorneys besides the lead, each with five or more years of water law practice. A plain head count cannot check the experience part, so it is marked not_checkable; attorney_count with value 3 (or 2) should not be scored as wrong.
party_notes: 'City of Saltbrook' is the service area, not the agency and not a party to check.
dates_that_are_not_deadlines: 'Site visit / conference .: none' means there is no conference deadline
not_requirements: T1 to T4: threshold requirements (these are the minimum qualifications)
the tick-box form lines in Schedule 5
8.1 to 8.6: conditions, including 150 day validity and a 5 working day protest period

extra_fields.source_line / source_line_no: on each deadline: the line of the RFP file (stripped, 1-based number) that states the date in force. For a date changed by addendum it is the addendum line; original_source_line is the line in the body.
extra_fields.section, numbered, text: on each requirement: the section it sits in, whether the RFP gives it a number or label, and its exact text with runs of white space collapsed to one space (the label itself is left out).
extra_fields.alt_labels, alt_qtypes: other labels or question types that a scorer should also accept. Question types are the test author's judgement.
extra_fields.deleted_requirements: requirements removed by addendum. They must NOT appear in the parsed requirement list.
extra_fields.evaluation_as_issued, forms_as_issued, b: values before any addendum, for checking that the change is shown.
extra_fields.addendum (on addendum_changes): which addendum made the change. Kinds beyond the existing keys: requirement_deleted, criterion_removed, weight_changed, insurance_changed, form_removed; time_from and time_to are given where an addendum changes the time of day.
extra_fields.amount_value: insurance amount as a whole number of dollars.
extra_fields.dates_that_are_not_deadlines: dates in the text that must not be read as schedule deadlines.
extra_fields.not_requirements: numbered or lettered items that are not proposal requirements (scope of services, general conditions, table of contents). Reading them as requirements is an error.
extra_fields.kind_not_in_existing_keys: marks a deadline kind the existing keys do not use; score it separately.
